name: Aoyagi Touya
source:
Touya is the strong, silent type. His father strictly brought him up on classical music, and he had an extraordinary sense of music thanks to the gifted education that he has received since he was young. However, it was his sharp disdain towards his father that led to his music life on the road.

He's part of the street music group Vivid BAD SQUAD.

[From in-game profile]
